description: This file contains shell functions to perform firmware upgrade procedures specifically for Netgear Orbi devices. It handles flashing kernel and root filesystem partitions based on a provided tar archive, including setup of loop devices and handling of overlay filesystem creation.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_netgear_orbi_upgrade
methods.description: Main entry point for upgrading Netgear Orbi devices; invokes the flashing process using provided tar archive, handling kernel and rootfs partitions.

methods.name: netgear_orbi_do_flash
methods.description: Performs the flashing of kernel and root filesystem, sets up loop devices, formats overlay storage, and copies configuration backup.
